parsed.draft_response:
Hi—sorry you’re running into this again. We understand the urgency, and we’ll get this investigated as a priority.

To make sure we’re looking at the exact failing behavior (since “nothing works” is currently too broad for us to pinpoint), could you reply with the minimum details below?
1) What exact workflow(s) fail? (e.g., login, uploading, search, saving data, integrations, checkout, etc.)
2) What do you see instead of the expected result? If there’s an error message, please paste the exact wording.
3) When did it start, and is it still happening right now?
4) Your environment/region: production or staging, and browser/app version (or device/OS).
5) If available, share any screenshot/screen recording and any request/correlation ID(s) shown in the UI.

As soon as we have that, we’ll escalate to engineering for immediate troubleshooting. In the meantime, if you can, please avoid making changes on your side that could alter the state (e.g., configuration updates) so we can match the issue to the reports from your last incident.
promised_actions: Escalate the ticket to engineering for immediate troubleshooting once the requested details are provided
safety_notes: Avoid claiming an outage/known cause or promising a fix/ETA based on insufficient information.
Request only the minimum useful diagnostic details to identify the failing feature/error.

grounded_facts: Customer states that the app is “broken again.”
Customer says the app “keeps doing the same thing as last time.”
Customer reports their boss is mad.
Customer says: “I do not have time to explain this again.”
Ticket classification marks category as “unclear,” needs human review as true, team as “engineering,” and urgency as “critical.”
missing_information: What “same thing as last time” refers to (previous incident details or symptoms).
Which app features or workflows are failing (e.g., login, payments, search, uploads).
Exact timeframe when the issue started and whether it is continuous or intermittent.
Any error messages, logs, screenshots, or stack traces shown to the customer.
Device/platform/browser/app version and environment (production vs staging, region).
Whether any recent changes (deployments, configuration, integrations) occurred before the issue began.

risk_signals: Ambiguous/unclear failure mode increases time-to-resolution due to insufficient diagnostics.
